Subject: Kickoff: Security exhibit + inspection scope for MSA Order Form

Hi Connor,

Thanks for taking this on. Procurement and security here at ClearPath want to lock down the security exhibit language and confirm inspection/pen-test logistics before we finalize the order form. High-level asks are below — I attached our internal security requirements (ClearPath_Security_Reqs_v1.pdf).

Key asks from our side:
- Confirmation that Redwood will accept an inspection/pen-test under the MSA security exhibit (SOC 2 + third-party pen).
- Pen-test window target: June 14–18 (staging) with a 10-business-day turnaround for a signed report.
- Evidence cadence: weekly bundle for documentation artifacts, and one final evidence drop post-pen-test.
- Access: limited staging credentials, scoped IP ranges, and an NDA for testers if required.
- Audit rights: sampling (last 90 days logs) + on-demand artifact collection (config, backups, MFA configs).

Can you confirm what you need from procurement/legal to proceed (PO, vendor forms, redline template)? If you can share Redwood’s proposed redlines for the exhibit, we’ll loop legal and security.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Park
Sr. InfoSec Manager | ClearPath Medical
security@clearpathmedical.com

Emily —

Appreciate the clear summary and the attachment. I’ve looped Legal (Laura) and our Assurance lead (Hannah) to map your asks to the MSA + Order Form. Initial responses / asks below.

1) Inspection / pen-test acceptance
- We accept a scoped pen-test under our security exhibit, subject to an agreed scope and pre-approved testing window. We prefer staged testing (non-prod) and require a brief runbook/target whitelist in advance.

2) Pen-test timing and report turnaround
- June 14–18 is workable. We typically aim to provide a signed findings summary within 10 business days. If you prefer faster turnaround, we can agree to a separate SLA but that needs a legal sign-off.

3) Evidence cadence & artifact list
- To reduce back-and-forth, attached is a proposed redline for the security exhibit and an "evidence manifest" outline (RDW_SecurityExhibit_Redline_20260523.docx). It contains artifact buckets we can produce on a weekly cadence: SOC 2 assertions mapping, recent config snapshots, network ACL summaries, RBAC/export of admin audit logs, and ephemeral staging snapshots.

4) Access and sampling
- We can provide time-boxed staging credentials and audited SSH bastion access. For log sampling we propose: 7-day full export + 30-day sampled indexes for the 90-day window. If you need full 90-day exports, that’s possible but has cost/processing lead time.

5) Vendor/legal items we need from you
- Procurement PO / order form target date and any expedited payment/penalty language you require.
- Any Legal redlines to the MSA security exhibit you must have accepted to proceed.

Next steps I propose:
- Laura to review redlines and call out legal blockers by EOD Monday.
- Hannah to own the evidence manifest and confirm what we can deliver by June 1.
- Sync call: Tue 5/26 at 10am PT to finalize scope and DocuSign timeline (I’ll send an invite).

Connor O'Brien
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: RDW_SecurityExhibit_Redline_20260523.docx (Word, 75KB)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com

Thanks — adding a few legal clarifications and requested edits. High level: we want to keep the MSA exhibit balanced but are willing to concede to a scoped inspection and sample-based evidence collection with the following caveats.

Legal asks / proposed language changes:
- Limit inspection rights to the production environment only where necessary; prefer staging for pen-tests. Any inspection of production must be notice-based and limited to agreed artifacts.
- Sampling definition: we propose "statistically representative samples" rather than blanket 90-day exports; if ClearPath requires full exports that will be handled by a signed Statement of Work with cost allocation.
- Pen-test vendor handling: vendor must be pre-approved and sign an NDA; we will provide a white-label report (findings and remediation) and can provide a redacted full report for your records.
- Evidence retention/access: we can supply snapshots and exports, but long-term retention or forensic exports beyond 90 days are out-of-scope without a separate agreement.

Operational notes:
- If ClearPath needs a 10-business-day signed report guaranteed by contract, we need to add a clause limiting liability related to third-party tester actions and a carve-out for issues discovered outside the scoped assets.

I’ll inline suggested redlines in the attached doc today. If those look OK, Connor — please confirm the June test window and Hannah, please confirm what artifact buckets we can commit to by June 1.

Laura Bennett
Counsel, Contracts & Security | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: RDW_SecurityExhibit_Redline_20260523.docx (updated with inline comments)
